Title: Canvas 2D: toDataURL() Readback
Description: Converts rendered canvas bitmap into a base64 Data URL. Differences in GPU rasterization, subpixel anti-aliasing, OS font renderers, and graphics drivers create a persistent hardware-specific hash.
Anti-Fraud Use: Widely used by FingerprintJS, DataDome, and Kasada to generate a unique per-device canvas fingerprint.
Mitigation: Inject subtle RGB color noise into pixel buffers or block unprompted readbacks.

Title: Canvas 2D: getImageData() Pixel Access
Description: Directly reads raw RGBA pixel array from a canvas context. Used to extract subtle rasterization and winding rule differences across client GPUs.
Anti-Fraud Use: Core component of canvas fingerprinting and anti-bot image validation.
Mitigation: Randomize low-order bits of RGB components.

Title: Canvas 2D: toBlob() Export
Description: Asynchronously exports canvas content as a Blob. Often used as an alternative to toDataURL to avoid detection.
Anti-Fraud Use: Used in modern background fingerprinting workers.
Mitigation: Spoof canvas buffer before blob serialization.

Title: Canvas 2D: measureText() Font Probing
Description: Measures exact width and typographic bounding box of text strings. When called in loops with different font families, reveals installed system fonts and OS font-rendering metrics.
Anti-Fraud Use: Identifies installed fonts without requesting font permissions.
Mitigation: Quantize text measurements to coarse fractional pixel boundaries.

Title: WebGL: getParameter() Hardware Inspection
Description: Queries underlying graphics hardware attributes. Specifically queries UNMASKED_VENDOR_WEBGL (0x9245) and UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL (0x9246) to extract GPU chipset and driver version.
Anti-Fraud Use: Links sessions across incognito modes; detects VM/headless environments (e.g. SwiftShader, Mesa, VMware).
Mitigation: Mask unmasked vendor/renderer to generic standard GPU strings.

Title: WebGL: Extension Enumeration
Description: Enumerates all supported WebGL extensions (e.g. ANGLE, anisotropic filtering). Extension lists vary depending on GPU capabilities and driver versions.
Anti-Fraud Use: Provides auxiliary entropy to differentiate GPU hardware revisions.

Title: WebGL: Shader Precision Fingerprint
Description: Retrieves floating-point precision format limits of vertex and fragment shaders supported by the GPU.
Anti-Fraud Use: Determines physical GPU microarchitecture capabilities.
Mitigation: Standardize precision ranges to IEEE 754 norms.

Title: WebGL: 3D Scene ReadPixels Fingerprint
Description: Renders complex 3D geometry with shaders and lighting, then reads back pixel buffer to compute a unique 3D hash.
Anti-Fraud Use: WebGL 3D canvas fingerprinting in advanced anti-fraud suites.

Title: WebGPU: Hardware Adapter Query
Description: Modern next-gen graphics API exposing deep GPU architecture, driver limits, and compute pipeline limits.
Anti-Fraud Use: Next-generation device fingerprinting bypassing WebGL protections.
Mitigation: Sanitize adapter info limits and features.

Title: Web Audio: OfflineAudioContext Rendering
Description: Generates audio waveforms through oscillators, dynamics compressors, and bi-quad filters, then captures the rendered PCM buffer. Math precision differences in CPU DSP operations produce unique audio hashes.
Anti-Fraud Use: Standard vector in FingerprintJS, Arkose Labs, and PerimeterX.
Mitigation: Inject minimal float frequency jitter into audio buffer.

Title: Web Audio: AnalyserNode FFT Data
Description: Retrieves Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) frequency spectrum data from active audio graphs.
Anti-Fraud Use: Alternative audio fingerprinting stream for real-time sound processing.

Title: WebRTC: ICE Candidate & Local IP Probing
Description: Gathers ICE candidates via STUN/TURN servers. Can expose public IP addresses behind proxies, VPN leakage, or local LAN IP addresses (or mDNS host candidates).
Anti-Fraud Use: Detects proxy/VPN masking, reveals residential IP vs datacenter proxy mismatches.
Mitigation: Restrict WebRTC ICE gathering to default proxy interfaces; block STUN queries.

Title: WebRTC: SDP Offer & Codec Inspection
Description: Creates Session Description Protocol (SDP) offer revealing supported audio/video codecs, SRTP profiles, and certificate fingerprints.
Anti-Fraud Use: Inspects media stack capabilities and browser internal build traits.

Title: Network: Localhost / Port Scanning Probe
Description: Attempts connections to 127.0.0.1 or local intranet on ports like 8080, 3000, 9222 (remote debugging), 8545 (Ethereum node), or torrent ports.
Anti-Fraud Use: Used by banking anti-fraud (e.g. ThreatMetrix) to detect developer tools, remote access Trojans, or proxy bots.
Mitigation: Block localhost / loopback cross-origin fetch requests.

Title: Network: sendBeacon Telemetry Transmission
Description: Asynchronously transmits telemetry and collected fingerprint payloads to remote collection servers during page lifecycle.
Anti-Fraud Use: Primary conduit for sending serialized client fingerprints back to anti-fraud servers.
Mitigation: Inspect and decode beacon payloads; optionally block unauthorized endpoints.

Title: Client Hints: getHighEntropyValues()
Description: Requests granular hardware and OS version details including exact architecture, OS bitness, platform version, and full version list.
Anti-Fraud Use: Replaces legacy User-Agent string with high-entropy verified client signals.
Mitigation: Limit client hints return values to low-entropy equivalents.

Title: Hardware: CPU Logical Cores
Description: Reports number of logical processor cores available on device (e.g. 4, 8, 16, 24).
Anti-Fraud Use: Categorizes device processing class; identifies single-core bot environments.

Title: Hardware: Device RAM (GB)
Description: Reports approximate device memory in gigabytes (e.g. 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8).
Anti-Fraud Use: Device tier segmentation and bot farm profiling.

Title: Screen: Display Resolution & Color Depth
Description: Inspects physical display dimensions, available workspace, taskbar offsets, and Retina/HiDPI devicePixelRatio.
Anti-Fraud Use: Multi-monitor detection and desktop environment profiling.

Title: Environment: Battery Status API
Description: Exposes battery level, charging status, and charging/discharging time estimates. High precision battery fractions act as a short-term tracking cookie.
Anti-Fraud Use: Cross-origin session stitching without cookies.
Mitigation: Block battery API access or return fixed 100% charging state.

Title: Environment: Network Information API
Description: Reports effective network type (4g, 3g), downlink speed, and round-trip time (rtt).
Anti-Fraud Use: Identifies mobile vs broadband connections and latency signatures.

Title: Media: Device Enumeration (enumerateDevices)
Description: Enumerates connected audio input/output and video cameras. Even without labels, device ID hashes and counts are highly unique.
Anti-Fraud Use: Device hardware fingerprinting; detects zero-device headless containers.
Mitigation: Return standard virtual single microphone & camera set.

Title: System: Speech Synthesis Voice Enumeration
Description: Enumerates built-in text-to-speech voice engines. The set of installed voices depends directly on OS version, language packs, and OEM additions.
Anti-Fraud Use: High-entropy fingerprinting vector commonly used by Russian/EU anti-fraud systems.
Mitigation: Standardize voices to basic default locale voice.

Title: Fonts: Local Font Access API
Description: Directly queries the full inventory of all locally installed fonts on the operating system.
Anti-Fraud Use: Ultimate font fingerprinting vector with near 100% device uniqueness.

Title: Anti-Bot: navigator.webdriver Flag Probe
Description: Anti-bot scripts check if navigator.webdriver is true or if Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor reveals automation bindings.
Anti-Fraud Use: Immediate bot flag trigger in Cloudflare Turnstile, DataDome, and Akamai.
Mitigation: Ensure navigator.webdriver is false and undetectable.

Title: Anti-Bot: ChromeDriver / Selenium Artifact Probe
Description: Probes for hidden global properties left behind by Selenium, Puppeteer, Playwright, or ChromeDriver.
Anti-Fraud Use: Identifies automated scrapers and headless browser sessions.

Title: Anti-Bot: Function.prototype.toString Integrity Check
Description: Checks if native browser functions have been hooked or monkey-patched by comparing string representation against '[native code]'.
Anti-Fraud Use: Detects naive ad-blockers, fingerprint spoofers, and extension modifications.

Title: WebAssembly: CPU Timing & Benchmark
Description: Executes tight WebAssembly loops to measure clock jitter, instruction cache performance, and CPU execution speed.
Anti-Fraud Use: Detects cloud VM execution and hyperthreading characteristics.

Title: Environment: Compute Pressure API
Description: Monitors device thermal state and CPU pressure levels.
Anti-Fraud Use: Resource profiling.

Title: Environment: Idle Detection API
Description: Monitors user screen lock and system idle state.
Anti-Fraud Use: Tracks user physical presence.

Title: Environment: Keyboard Layout Map
Description: Returns physical keyboard layout mapping (QWERTY, AZERTY, DVORAK, Cyrillic).
Anti-Fraud Use: Regional identification and language mismatch detection.

Title: Permissions: Permissions.query() Probing
Description: Probes state of browser permissions (geolocation, camera, notifications, clipboard). Unusual patterns reveal automated or modified profiles.
Anti-Fraud Use: Validates browser profile authenticity.

Title: Clipboard: readText() / read()
Description: Attempts reading clipboard buffer contents.
Anti-Fraud Use: Detects clipboard hijacking or crypto address substitution.
